#WATCH Cuttack, Odisha: Police conduct flag march ahead of Kali Puja immersion

DCP Rishikesh D Khilari says, "Tomorrow, the immersion for Kali Puja will be carried out...for which all arrangements have been made. Some special teams have also been formed...a traffic advisory has also been issued so that people do not face any inconvenience. Adequate security forces have been deployed...we request the people not to believe any kind of rumours..."
